import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H,W,_ = img.shape
# Downsample to 64x40 ascii using luminance + hue labels
small = np.array(Image.fromarray(img).resize((64,40), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR))
def label(px):
    r,g,b = px
    mx,mn = max(px),min(px)
    if mx<40: return ' '       # dark bg
    if r>150 and g>150 and b>150:
        if abs(int(r)-int(g))<12 and abs(int(g)-int(b))<12: return '.'  # grey/white
    if r>120 and r>g+25 and r>b+15: return 'P'  # pink/red
    if r>100 and g>60 and b<80 and r>b+30: return 'o'  # wood/brown
    if g>r and g>b: return 'g'
    if b>r and b>g: return 'B'
    if r>80 and g>70 and b<70: return 'w'  # wood
    return '#'
for y in range(40):
    print(''.join(label(small[y,x]) for x in range(64)))
EOF"
